mutations.description: Restore the compositor policy that never redraws the result layer, so completed text never reaches the screen.
mutations.before:
wantsLayer = true
    layerContentsRedrawPolicy = .onSetNeedsDisplay
    layer?.masksToBounds = true
    setAccessibilityRole(.textArea)
mutations.after:
wantsLayer = true
    layerContentsRedrawPolicy = .never
    layer?.masksToBounds = true
    setAccessibilityRole(.textArea)

mutations.description: Ignore empty renderer replacements so the previous result survives a new submission.
Keep the previous result record instead of replacing it with the new submission.
Report an edited source or a changed action as still matching the result.
Keep the previous action when the panel is shown again instead of returning to 翻译.
Stop publishing composer metrics after native edits so the source pane never resizes.
mutations.before:
onVirtualDocumentChange(nil, nil, nil)
        var updatedMetrics = ComposerTextMetrics(text: updatedText)
        updatedMetrics.naturalHeight = Self.naturalHeight(of: textView)
        metrics.wrappedValue = updatedMetrics

mutations.description: Route every Command-C to the result even while the source has a selection.
mutations.before:
guard let textView = window?.firstResponder as? NSTextView else { return false }
    return textView.selectedRange().length > 0

mutations.description: Send the translation source/target languages during improvement so the model follows the selector instead of the input text.
mutations.before:
case .improve:
      languageBehavior = .preserveSource
      sourceLanguage = nil
      targetLanguage = nil
mutations.after:
case .improve:
      languageBehavior = .preserveSource
      sourceLanguage = request.sourceLanguage
      targetLanguage = request.targetLanguage
